article.title: 品牌案例：Optimizely用懸疑短劇接觸B2B行銷人
article.title_en: Brand case: Optimizely uses a murder-mystery microdrama to reach B2B marketers
article.summary: 11月2日公告介紹Murder in Marketing：直式短劇已推出，長片定於11月13日首映。
article.summary_en: A November 2 announcement describes a live vertical series and a film premiere planned for November 13.
highlights: 直式短劇於10月30日開始，並非11月2日才首播。
highlights_en: The vertical series began October 30, before the announcement.
Distribution includes TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.
article.why: B2B品牌可從受眾熟悉的工作情境切入，評估故事內容能否引發同業討論。
article.why_en: B2B brands can explore workplace stories that invite discussion among professional audiences.
article.next_step: 先用一個真實工作矛盾寫短篇故事，再設定完播與後續互動指標。
article.next_step_en: Build a short story around a real workplace tension and define viewing and follow-up measures.
article.detail: 這部由Optimizely與Caspian Studios合作的作品，把行銷團隊的職場壓力放進虛構懸疑故事。公告區分已推出的直式短劇，以及11月13日才首映的長片。本報將它作為AI行銷平台的品牌內容案例，並非宣稱影片由AI生成。公司希望以娛樂建立關係，尚未提供這個活動的獨立觀看或商業轉換結果；新聞稿引用的整體短劇市場數據亦未用來證明此案例有效。
article.detail_en: Optimizely and Caspian Studios turn workplace marketing pressures into fiction. This is a content-marketing case from an AI platform, not a claim of AI-generated production. The film is still scheduled; no independent campaign viewing or business-conversion result is established.
